min_concentration.description: How aligned the fitted segment directions must be before the estimate is trusted. Rejects corners, signs and open sides, where heading is worse than none.

baseline_rays.description: Ray separation between the two returns forming one segment. Wider is less noisy but blurs a real corner into the straight.

max_segment_jump_m.description: Range step above which two returns are treated as different surfaces rather than one continuous wall.

min_segment_m.description: Segments shorter than this are dominated by range noise, not wall direction.

near_max_range_m.description: Returns at or beyond this are no-return rays sanitised to max range by the driver, not real surfaces. The C1 reports 12 m; this sits just under it.

min_returns.description: Fewer usable returns than this cannot form a segment at all.
